verdict.rationale: Orb documents its own managed, daily exports of resource types to a data destination of the customer's choice, plus revenue exports for financial systems, so a first-party bulk export capability exists. The evidence does not say these exports cover all account data, does not name open file formats, and does not describe an offboarding or exit path. missing for 10: confirmation that exports cover all data (events, customers, invoices, plans), named open formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/JSON), documented offboarding/leave workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.
Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.
